description: Non-destructive normalization plan for imported Nemisis Project weapon and character GLBs. Source binaries are not edited; tools/blender/normalize_project_assets.py can audit or export reproducible normalized GLBs from this metadata.

findings: Contains exported Icosphere helper mesh that distorts whole-file bounds.
No authored Nemisis socket_root, socket_camera, socket_weapon_root, hand sockets, or col_ collision proxy.
Visible character mesh is offset from origin by roughly +0.103m X and -0.109m Y in Blender space.
No explicit HK416 path, metadata, material, or object-name match was found; this M4A1 asset is the closest rifle candidate.
Current sidecar dimensions understate actual weapon length because only part of the model appears to have been measured.
Weapon height is on Blender +X while Nemisis target assets use Blender +Z up, so the configured fix rolls source +X to target +Z.
No authored socket_muzzle, grip sockets, eject socket, or col_ collision proxy.
Axis layout already matches Blender +Z up and +Y forward in an isolated import.
Rifle height is large for a shoulder weapon, but this may be intentional sci-fi styling.
